items.summary: Handoff: retain the CRO signals as prioritization evidence only. Do not infer financial upside from impressions, rankings, CTR targets, performance scores, or sessions. Continue period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation; preserve unknown ROI, margin, payback, and cost-to-learn.

Recommendation: approve containment-only execution. Reject new spend, forecasts, monetization expansion, and unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the aggregate row is not site-attributable, so $0 site-attributed commission does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost windows do not align; AI-cost records conflict ($881.36 across 4,832 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27 versus retained $973.35 across 5,439 calls); infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and approved-budget records are absent or incomplete; and experiments lack defined incremental costs and learning outcomes. Treat impressions, rankings, CTR targets, performance scores, sessions, conversions, ordered items, and AI usage as operating metrics, not financial returns. Continue only existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation. Minimum measurement: one identical reporting window reconciling attributable revenue, attribution, AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, and experiment learning-outcome records.
